name: Sulphur Mountain
crs: EPSG:4326 for every GeoJSON; trees.csv is in the local frame below

frame.axes: x east, y north, metres (equirectangular at origin_lat): lng = origin_lng + x/metres_per_deg_lng, lat = origin_lat + y/metres_per_deg_lat
frame.note: WGS84 meridional / prime-vertical radii at origin_lat (a=6378137, f=1/298.257223563). C15.3 corrected from prior approximate constants.

aoi.note: the surveyed parcel padded 150 m; the lidar-derived layers cover this box (clipped at its west edge to the lidar tile)

survey.what: boundary (11 corners), the 11 calls with bearing and distance, the 16 ft access easement (2 parts), 4 found monuments

county.what: assessor parcel ring (kept for the drift, never for siting), 3 building footprints with their 2018 lidar heights, road centrelines

roofs.what: roof planes recovered from the lidar under-canopy surface: the house, a shed, and McQueen's Garage (the 3,200 sq ft warehouse the county does not map)

trees_crowns.what: 2018 lidar tree crown circles from trees.csv for map overlay

trees_trunks.what: 2018 lidar tree trunk points from trees.csv

trees.units: decimetres, integers, in the pack frame
trees.method: 0.5 m canopy height model (highest return minus the 1 m ground), roofs masked, variable-window local maxima (window 1.2 m + 0.28 x height), watershed crowns; tops under 2.5 m are not listed

cultivated.units: decimetres, integers, in the pack frame — same as trees.csv
cultivated.what: planted positions (orchard rows). No meshes — the engine instances by species like wild trees. Generated by scripts/cultivated.py.

cultivated_ground.what: footprints for orchard blocks and garden beds that keep the wild vegetation rule out of cultivated ground

oak_leaf_knoll.what: C12 site analysis of the Oak Leaf knoll: 0.5 m contours, slope classes, largest contiguous <15% buildable envelope, surveyed oaks with drip-line protection zones over a 100×100 m window. Analysis only — no house.

drainage.what: D8 flow channels from the pack 1 m DEM (sink-filled); contributing area >= 2000 m2; Strahler order; simplify ~1 m. Main line checked against the creek ford.
drainage.units: m2 accum / percent slope / Strahler order

horizon.method: horizon altitude every 0.5 deg; eye 1.6 m; 1 m DEM to 1.5 km; NED 10 m to 30 km; curvature + refraction

sky_events.method: astronomy-engine sun/moon vs horizon.json; cross-quarters traditional only

keylines.method: keypoints on valley lines; keylines at contour; swale 0.5-1%; topo_drain core (MIT)

twi.method: breached depressions + D8 topographic wetness index

wind_sea_breeze.method: sheltering index for wind from 270 deg (W); Ojai REC daytime westerly onshore
wind_sea_breeze.what: sheltering index for wind from 270 deg (W); Ojai REC daytime westerly onshore

wind_santa_ana.method: sheltering index for wind from 45 deg (NE); NWS SoCal Santa Ana
wind_santa_ana.what: sheltering index for wind from 45 deg (NE); NWS SoCal Santa Ana

landforms.method: TPI classes at 20 m and 100 m scales
landforms.what: TPI classes at 20 m and 100 m scales

corridors.method: Circuitscape-style current flow (scipy) creek to woodland
corridors.what: Circuitscape-style current flow (scipy) creek to woodland

positions.what: one row per placed thing: every models.json model, named site features (well, ford, gate, road entry, pads), and survey corners. Columns include WGS84, EPSG:32611 UTM 11N, pack frame EN, DEM elev, POB polar, footprint area, parcel clearance

vision.what: the 18 proposed project zones from the atlas as points at their placed positions; each is a placeholder until it has a model. Properties: id, name, type, mode (today | vision | both), summary, and a 2018 lidar note where a structure stands today
vision.source: the atlas: properties/sulphur-mountain.js for the zones, data/zone-positions.json for the placed positions
vision.territories: none carried — the atlas's zone polygons are 0.001-degree grid cells that do not contain their own icons; real territories come from a drawing on the aerial

imagery.note: streamed live, never committed; about 12 cm per pixel at z20

terrain.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m (CA_SoCal_Wildfires_B3_2018), baked by the atlas 2026-09-17; the 13 tiles are kept here so the ground loads with the pack

terrain_hillshade.what: 1 m DEM hillshade RGBA underlay for the map UI

edits.note: applied by the world on top of the record: op remove on layer trees, a Point with radius_m or a Polygon with buffer_m

materials.note: close-up ground, road and bark materials: CC0 tiles recoloured to the owner's photographs of the land

models.what: the proposed structures as walkable GLB models, each built by its script in scripts/ and committed here; extras.walk carries the floors and solids the engine walks

stormwater_depth.method: 1-in-10 1-hr ~25 mm sheet-flow depth proxy on 1 m grid

cold_air.method: downslope cold-air accumulation + hollow TPI pools

gathers.method: C20 alias of buildable for one phase

gathering.method: weighted overlay; canopy earns shade; trunks exclude 1.5 m
gathering.what: where people would want to gather (oaks welcome)

defensible_space.what: Geometric reading of published 0-5 / 5-30 / 30-100 ft defensible-space distances. Not a fire-agency inspection. No tree removal is implied.

water_harvest.what: Keyline swale catchments and pond sites sized to a 25 mm event

capture_plan.what: C14 phone-scan walk order: ~20 m zones with 3 m overlap

scans.what: Gaussian-splat placement records; binary scans stay in private storage (scans/ git-ignored)

trees_instances.what: 16 oak archetypes + 3663 instances fitted to trees.csv

sources.name: Henry Land Surveying Inc. — topographic survey, Jeremy Henry PLS 8135
sources.record_map: 14-PM-15 (Parcel Maps Book 14, Page 15, Ventura County Recorder)

sources.name: USGS 3DEP Lidar Point Cloud, CA_SoCAL_Wildfires_2018_D18 / CA_SoCal_Wildfires_B3_2018, tile w2091n1519
sources.density: 6-7.5 points per m2 at the house; classes ground and unclassified only

sources.name: Ventura County GIS (maps.ventura.org ArcGIS REST): SDs/Parcels/0, DataDownloads/CommonData/0 footprints, DataDownloads/Transportation/15 road centrelines, SDs/2025UrbanAerial
EcoVillage-map (the atlas): survey transcription, footprints bake, Vision zones, baked 1 m terrain

reconciliation.what: a large tree beside the house
reconciliation.note: the lidar is 2018 and shows the house under 12 m of canopy; the owner's photographs of 2026-09-17 show no large tree at the house. Which of these four (or all) came down is to be confirmed on site; until then the world draws them
reconciliation.resolution: edits.geojson#trees-around-the-house removes every 2018 tree top within 12 m of the house footprint (14 trees, 6.9-14.7 m); the record in trees.csv is untouched

reconciliation.what: county footprint #1 (38 m2, classed FIELD AND SEED CROPS) has no lidar returns above 0.5 m — it is the survey's concrete pad; the world does not raise it

reconciliation.status: in lidar, not in county footprints
reconciliation.what: McQueen's Garage, the 3,200 sq ft warehouse: a 157 m2 planar roof at 4.0 m (roofs.geojson #0) 2 m from the zone anchor; the county's footprint layer has no structure here

the sheet's five sheds, wood fences, power poles and dirt roads exist only on the registered raster in the atlas (images/sulphur-mountain/survey/topo-survey-overlay.png, ~0.3 m/px); the fence walk supplies these
county ring vs surveyed line: 8.7 m Hausdorff, up to 29 ft west on the west side, 9.498 vs 9.466 acres
at The Barn's anchor the 2018 lidar shows a low roof of about 2.2 m and roughly 28 m2 under canopy — smaller than the word suggests; to confirm on the fence walk
the atlas's 14 zone polygons are 0.001-degree grid cells that do not contain their own icons; only the placed points are carried. Real territories come from a drawing on the aerial

rules: survey beats county beats derived; a later date beats an earlier one only with a source
the county ring is kept to show the drift and is never used for siting
imagery and terrain are streamed by URL from their publishers and are never bulk-copied into this repository
nothing here names a person: no owner names, no residents, no purchased data

pack_layers.what: RGBA display rasters and drawable vector layers for the map UI
